title: 圆点小阶梯
description: 木版画风格把圆润大点排成低矮阶梯，动作轻松、形体清晰。

art_direction.medium: hand-painted oil illustration with restrained impasto
art_direction.scene: Create an original two-tone woodcut-style illustration of a fictional clothed adult moving through a short staircase of rounded jug holds on a low vertical wall. The hand sequence rises only modestly, and the foot sequence remains close to a broad padded floor that fills the foreground. The figure stands through a bent front leg while keeping the other foot engaged, rather than hanging from both arms. Use a wide oblique composition with bold carved contours, warm indigo, ivory paper, and a few ochre hold accents. Make the wall texture distinct from the clothing. Retain believable hand placement and adult proportions. No lettering, brands, or dramatic exposure.
